units.source_text: 不多久，他翻身朝向那边。

en.t: Before long, he turned over and faced that way.

units.source_text: 我翻开明天要考试的英语教科书。

en.t: I opened the English textbook for the exam I had the next day.

units.source_text: 我的世界仿佛被推到一寸见方的局限中去，牢牢地固定在那里了。

en.t: It was as if my world had been pushed into the confines of a single square inch and fixed firmly there.

units.source_text: 今晚祖父的声音，已经不是这个人世间的声音了。

en.t: Tonight, Grandfather's voice was no longer a voice of this world.

units.source_text: 美代回去以后，我几次想把自己将来的希望告诉祖父，借以安慰他。

en.t: After Miyo went home, several times I thought of telling Grandfather about my hopes for the future, hoping to comfort him with them.

units.source_text: 夜深了，祖父仿佛从深渊中忽然冒出一句话：

en.t: Late in the night, Grandfather suddenly seemed to bring up a sentence from the depths:
